correctness.rationale: For a uniform residue mod Q_Y the CRT yields independent signed Bernoulli divisibility indicators with probabilities 1/p; for independent uniform units u,v mod Q_Y, the local event p|u²+v² has probability 2/(p-1) for p≡1(mod4) and 0 for p≡3(mod4). I independently enumerated local unit pairs and CRT classes (1155 combinations) confirming these nonstandard normalizations. Dirichlet-class Mertens supplies H_Y=loglog Y+O(1) and signed sum O(1), so per H_Y log-mgf limits are cosh(t)-1 and exp(t)-1. Exponential tilts at asinh(1/2) and -log 2, plus a bounded tilted triangular-array CLT on intervals of width H^(2/3), yield matching lower and upper rates (1/2)log(phi)+1-sqrt5/2 and (1-log2)/2. Careful strict inequality on square-unit tail shifts threshold only by O(1), immaterial asymptotically. Finite CRT checks do not prove infinite rates.

originality.rationale: Qualified best-of-knowledge PASS for two explicit exact logarithmic exceptional-tail rates along all odd-prime cutoffs. Yan–Xu arXiv:2610.28237 defines the two sets with second-moment bounds O(1/H); its available Lemma 2.1 summary does not provide exponential asymptotics. Standard Gartner–Ellis, Cramér tilting and mod-Poisson frameworks yield the mechanism when applied and could imply the result as a corollary; specific arithmetic local Bernoulli success probabilities and sharp constants are computed here. Specialist prior deviations work may cover the specialization.
